name: Catalog sync
description: Converts owner-approved scripts into TikTok Shop product drafts and sends them to the restaurant-social-commerce-engine API. Never creates or modifies live products without an approval token.
steps: For each approved script, build a product draft: title, description, price, category, and image references derived from the script's demo section.
Validate the draft against the commerce engine schema (required fields, price format, category enum).
Call commerce-engine MCP 'product.create' in DRAFT (not published) status only.
Attach the approval_token from the approval-gate skill to the request so the commerce engine can audit who approved it.
Return the created draft IDs and a status summary to the owner.
